paper.core_task: Unsupervised categorical pose estimation from images

contributions.name: A hierarchical memory module for learning pose priors
contributions.author_claim_text: We propose a new method called Pose Prior Learner (PPL) for unsupervised pose estimation.
contributions.description: A method that learns a general categorical pose prior in an unsupervised manner using a hierarchical memory to store and distill prototypical poses, avoiding the need for human annotations.

contributions.name: An iterative inference strategy for occluded scenes
contributions.author_claim_text: During inference, we utilize an iterative strategy in which PPL progressively leverages priors to refine estimated poses by regressing them to the nearest prototypical poses stored in memory.
contributions.description: A strategy that iteratively uses reconstructed images as input to refine pose estimates, leveraging stored prototypical poses and learned priors to handle occlusions.

novelty_claims.text: However I believe the idea of this work is still built on the foundation from these previous works.
